text: In the 1980s, book banners pressured over 20 public libraries, schools, and community centers across the country to remove Our Bodies, Ourselves from their shelves. The school districts of Renton, Washington, and Ludlow, Massachusetts, removed the book from their high school curricula.
meta_description: Our Bodies, Ourselves: in the 1980s over 20 libraries, schools and centers were pressured to remove it; two school districts dropped it from curricula.
changes: Light restructure; removals tied to the 1980s pressure campaign as the source does.
